title: Scalable Cox Regression via Grouped Risk Sets and Sharper LogSumExp Rates
abstract: arXiv:2609.40120v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Motivated by the computational challenges of large-scale Cox regression, we study stochastic minimization of LogSumExp objectives over large sets. Mini-batch normalizer estimates generally yield biased gradients. We instead use a softplus surrogate that introduces one auxiliary scalar per normalizer and admits unbiased single-sample gradients. For smooth convex LogSumExp objectives, we prove an $O(T^{-1/2})$ averaged objective bound, improving the previous $T^{-1/4}$ analysis. With a strongly convex regularizer on the original variable, we also obtain a last-iterate squared-error rate of $\widetilde{O}(T^{-1})$ without strong convexity in the auxiliary variables. For Cox regression, the normalizers are defined over nested risk sets. We exploit this structure by grouping neighboring failures and sharing one auxiliary variable per group. translated_title: 基于分组风险集与更优LogSumExp收敛率的可扩展Cox回归
translated_abstract: 受大规模Cox回归计算挑战的启发，我们研究了在大型集合上随机最小化LogSumExp目标的问题。小批量归一化估计通常会产生有偏梯度。我们转而采用一种softplus替代方法，该方法为每个归一化器引入一个辅助标量，并允许无偏的单样本梯度。对于光滑凸的LogSumExp目标，我们证明了$O(T^{-1/2})$的平均目标界，改进了此前$T^{-1/4}$的分析结果。通过对原始变量施加强凸正则化，我们在辅助变量无需强凸性的条件下，还获得了$\widetilde{O}(T^{-1})$的最后迭代点平方误差率。对于Cox回归，归一化器定义在嵌套风险集上。我们通过将相邻失效事件分组并在每组共享一个辅助变量来利用这一结构。所得的压缩目标具有一致的得分与曲率界，从而控制误差。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于softplus替代与分组风险集的可扩展Cox回归方法，将LogSumExp目标的收敛率从T^{-1/4}改进至O(T^{-1/2})，并在强凸正则化下获得O~(T^{-1})的最后迭代点误差率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes scalable Cox regression via a softplus surrogate with unbiased single-sample gradients and grouped risk sets, improving LogSumExp convergence rates from T^{-1/4} to O(T^{-1/2}) and achieving a last-iterate rate of O~(T^{-1}) under strongly convex regularization.
